events.title_zh: OpenCode 1.18.34：修复新版 macOS 二进制运行问题
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 调整 macOS 二进制签名，改善本地编译产物在 macOS 27 及以上系统的运行可靠性。
key_points_zh: 本地编译后的 macOS 二进制重新签名；官方 CLI 发布包使用 Developer ID 签名。
模型请求携带带命名空间的会话及父会话身份头。
events.importance_reason_zh: 直接影响 macOS 用户能否可靠运行 CLI。
events.title_en: OpenCode 1.18.34: fixes for macOS binary execution
events.summary_en: OpenCode adjusts macOS binary signing to improve the reliability of locally compiled binaries on macOS 27 and later.
key_points_en: Locally compiled macOS binaries are re-signed; official CLI releases use Developer ID signing.
Model requests include namespaced session and parent-session identity headers.
events.importance_reason_en: Directly affects whether macOS users can run the CLI reliably.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.90：支持 GPT-6.1 Sol 与 GitHub MCP 认证
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 正式版本加入 GPT-6.1 Sol 支持，并改进 GitHub MCP 身份授权、会话权限与连接恢复。
key_points_zh: 新增 GPT-6.1 Sol 模型支持。
--mcp-github-auth 可将 GitHub 账号认证用于获准的 MCP 来源。
改进 MCP 发现与临时故障恢复，以及会话恢复后的权限响应。
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响模型选择、第三方工具接入和长会话连续性。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.90: GPT-6.1 Sol support and GitHub MCP authentication
events.summary_en: This stable Copilot CLI release adds GPT-6.1 Sol support and improves GitHub MCP authentication, session permissions and connection recovery.
key_points_en: Adds support for the GPT-6.1 Sol model.
--mcp-github-auth allows GitHub account authentication for approved MCP sources.
Improves MCP discovery, recovery from transient failures and permission responses after resuming a session.
events.importance_reason_en: Affects model selection, third-party tool integration and continuity in long sessions.

events.title_zh: Pi 0.99.2：MCP 延迟加载不再阻塞首个提示
events.summary_zh: Pi 改善默认 codemode 下的 MCP 工具加载，并扩展认证及供应商兼容性。
key_points_zh: MCP 工具延迟加载，首个提示无需等待全部工具准备完成。
新增 searchTools 与 describeNamespace 工具发现方式。
支持 Anthropic 工作负载联合认证配置；改进 MCP 作用域与供应商重试行为。
events.importance_reason_zh: 降低工具多的项目启动等待，并改善企业认证接入。
events.title_en: Pi 0.99.2: lazy MCP loading no longer blocks the first prompt
events.summary_en: Pi improves MCP tool loading in the default codemode and expands authentication and provider compatibility.
key_points_en: MCP tools load lazily, so the first prompt does not have to wait for all tools to be ready.
Adds searchTools and describeNamespace for tool discovery.
Supports Anthropic workload identity federation configuration; improves MCP scopes and provider retries.
events.importance_reason_en: Reduces startup delays in projects with many tools and improves enterprise authentication integration.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.286：修复会话记录丢失与凭据脱敏
events.summary_zh: 这一版本修复并行工具调用后恢复会话可能丢失后续轮次的问题，并堵住多种日志和 MCP 错误中的凭据脱敏遗漏。
key_points_zh: 崩溃或被终止后，--resume 与 --continue 不再因并行工具调用丢失后续轮次。
修复 Bearer/Basic、百分号编码及不可见字符情况下的凭据屏蔽遗漏。
组织关闭 Remote Control 后，现有远程会话会断开并提示。
events.importance_reason_zh: 会话历史与凭据保护都影响实际使用，值得及时关注。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.286: session history recovery and credential redaction fixes
events.summary_en: This release fixes the loss of subsequent turns when resuming sessions after parallel tool calls, and closes credential redaction gaps in logs and MCP errors.
key_points_en: After a crash or termination, --resume and --continue no longer lose subsequent turns due to parallel tool calls.
Fixes credential masking gaps involving Bearer/Basic authentication, percent encoding and invisible characters.
Existing remote sessions disconnect with a notice when an organization disables Remote Control.
events.importance_reason_en: Session history and credential protection both affect everyday use and deserve timely attention.
